text: The two header lines of R8.1 and the v4 change-log row sit on a new opening slide; the version 3 cover is kept as the first slide of the kept section (slide 13).
why: An existing file is never edited and a version is produced by copying (R8.2); the deck has no title-page placeholder that can be rewritten in place.
read: Template and Rules R8.1, R8.2; version 3 cover
impact: The deck opens with version 4; version 3 content follows unchanged.

text: Wave bands use the service wave table of R4 and the business-epic wave map of R5.6; a legacy key with no wave takes the wave of its service epic or integration epic.
why: Nineteen legacy keys carry no wave value (CG-D2-CTO-4) and the wave is fixed for services and business epics.
read: Template and Rules R4, R5.1, R5.6; Arch v5 slide 41 (wave column); ownership map Services sheet
impact: Wave 0 has 7 platform epics and no service; Waves 1 to 4 carry 9, 4, 4 and 2 services.

text: Release dates are not stated per wave. The wave slide carries the placeholder "Not specified in the source documents (CG-D2-CTO-1; ASM-D2-CTO-3)" instead of a date.
why: No source gives a date per wave, and a date is never invented or raised as a gap of type date (R1 U7).
read: split_plan.json legacy; version 3 slides 1 and 7; Template and Rules R9
impact: The wave slide shows no date; every other date in the deck is kept as issued.

text: Owners are shown as the service code of the Ownership Map plus the suggested owner per work type (TechX, ACE team, SCB IT infrastructure, DevOps team, QA team); no person and no named team is attached to a service.
why: Ownership is soft by decision (R1 U3, DL46) and no accountable team per service exists in the sources (CG-D2-CTO-3).
read: Template and Rules R1 U3, R5.3; ownership map Services sheet
impact: Every owner statement in the deck is a suggestion that any team may pick up.

text: Day-1 and lane totals are taken as given from split_plan stats: 1,034 slices, 358 legacy stories, 939 ready on Day 1, 510 lanes and 5 team types.
why: The split plan is the planning baseline of D-RCV-60; the deck reports it and does not recompute it.
impact: If the split plan changes, the Day-1 slide changes with it.

text: Statements of the version 3 slides are kept word for word and are mapped, statement by statement, to the decision that supersedes them, instead of being rewritten.
why: An existing file is never edited (R8.2) and the source content must be kept; the conflict with Architecture v5 is recorded (CG-D2-CTO-2).
read: Version 3 slides 2 to 7; Arch v5; Template and Rules R3, R8.2
impact: A reader sees the old and the new position side by side, with the decision named.

text: Every release date in the deck is marked tentative; the version 3 date of 28 October 2026 is kept unchanged as the date of that version.
why: Dates are tentative and unchanged (R1 U7, DL48), and a date is never raised as a gap.
read: Template and Rules R1 U7; version 3 slide 1
impact: No date in the deck is presented as committed.

text: The footer page number of each kept version 3 slide follows its new position (13 to 19); no other content of those slides is touched.
why: The new section sits in front, so a kept slide would otherwise show a number that no longer matches its position.
impact: Slide numbers are consistent across the deck; every statement, ID, count and date of version 3 is unchanged.
